components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Ink-background pill button; the default non-accent action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:0.6em; padding:0.95rem 1.75rem; border-radius:999px; font-family:var(--font-body); font-weight:600; font-size:0.95rem; background:var(--colour-ink); color:var(--colour-bg); border:1px solid transparent; cursor:pointer; transition:transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#000; transform:translateY(-2px); box-shadow:0 10px 30px -12px rgb(17 17 17 / 0.45); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:translateY(0); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--colour-ink); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Lime CTA Button
components.description: The signature, highest-commitment CTA — lime fill, deep-lime-ink text.
components.css: .ds-btn-lime { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:0.6em; padding:0.95rem 1.75rem; border-radius:999px; font-family:var(--font-body); font-weight:600; font-size:0.95rem; background:var(--colour-lime); color:var(--colour-lime-ink); border:1px solid transparent; cursor:pointer; transition:transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-lime:hover { transform:translateY(-2px); box-shadow:0 10px 30px -10px rgb(200 245 96 / 0.55); } .ds-btn-lime:active { transform:translateY(0); } .ds-btn-lime:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--colour-lime); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action next to a primary/lime button.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:0.6em; padding:0.95rem 1.75rem; border-radius:999px; font-family:var(--font-body); font-weight:600; font-size:0.95rem; background:transparent; color:var(--colour-ink); border:1px solid var(--colour-border); cursor:pointer; transition:transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { border-color:var(--colour-ink); transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--colour-ink); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Wordmark
components.description: Staple-bracket icon + "Stapled" wordmark; the trailing dot is always lime, on any background.
components.html: Stapled.
components.css: .ds-wordmark { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:0.4em; font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:700; font-size:1.375rem; letter-spacing:-0.01em; color:var(--colour-ink); line-height:1; } .ds-wordmark__mark { display:inline-flex; color:var(--colour-muted); opacity:0.85; } .ds-wordmark__dot { color:var(--colour-lime); }

components.name: Eyebrow Label
components.description: Uppercase section-intro tag with a lime dot prefix; precedes every section heading.
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:0.5em; font-family:var(--font-body); font-size:0.8125rem; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:0.08em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--colour-muted); } .ds-eyebrow::before { content:""; width:0.5em; height:0.5em; border-radius:2px; background:var(--colour-lime); flex-shrink:0; }

components.name: Card
components.description: White, hairline-bordered content container; flat at rest, lifts on hover.
components.html:
South Coast Electrical

A clean, trustworthy lead-generation website for a local electrical business.
components.css: .ds-card { background:var(--colour-white); border:1px solid var(--colour-border); border-radius:24px; padding:1.5rem; transition:transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-card:hover { transform:translateY(-4px); box-shadow:0 30px 50px -30px rgb(17 17 17 / 0.25); } .ds-card h3 { font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:600; font-size:1.15rem; margin:0 0 0.6rem; color:var(--colour-ink); } .ds-card p { margin:0; color:var(--colour-muted); font-size:0.95rem; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Labelled text input; flat with a hairline border, plain ink focus outline.
components.css: .ds-field { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:0.5rem; font-family:var(--font-body); } .ds-field span { font-size:0.85rem; font-weight:600; color:var(--colour-ink); } .ds-field input { background:var(--colour-white); border:1px solid var(--colour-border); border-radius:8px; padding:0.75rem 0.9rem; font:inherit; color:var(--colour-ink); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--colour-ink); outline-offset:1px; }

components.name: Pill Chip
components.description: Unfilled, hairline-bordered pill for informational tags and form radio choices.
components.css: .ds-chip { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; border:1px solid var(--colour-border); border-radius:999px; padding:0.5rem 1.1rem; font-family:var(--font-body); font-size:0.85rem; color:var(--colour-ink); background:var(--colour-white); }

narrative.overview:
The staple is both the literal brand mark and the governing metaphor: a small, precise, structural fastener that joins two things together with intention — here, a good local business and a website that actually represents it. Nothing about the system is loud by default. It sits on warm paper (#f5f3ee) with near-black ink type (#111111), flat surfaces, and thin hairline borders — honest and unpolished-corporate rather than glossy-agency. Signal lime (#c8f560) is the one bright, deliberate mark: it appears as a dot, an underline, a single CTA, a numeral badge — never as a wash of color across a surface. The voice matching this system is warm, direct and unpretentious, written in Matt's own first person, never a corporate "we".

The system deliberately keeps a distance from three things: the generic template/stock-agency look (default corporate blue, stock-photo hero banners, cookie-cutter DIY-builder polish) that Stapled. is explicitly positioned against; anything overly playful or whimsical (mascots, novelty display fonts, cartoonish illustration) that would undercut credibility with tradespeople and professional local clients; and dense, dashboard-like enterprise UI, even in utility sections like the enquiry form.
keyCharacteristics: A single accent color (lime) used as punctuation, never as a fill
Flat, hairline-bordered surfaces at rest; soft shadow reserved for floating device mockups and hover feedback
Pill radius (999px) for anything tappable, soft 24px rectangles for content containers, no sharp corners
A recurring "eyebrow" label (uppercase + lime dot) introduces every section
Full-bleed light/dark section banding down the page, not a site-wide dark mode

rules.name: The One Staple Rule
rules.body: Lime marks a single deliberate point per view — a dot, one CTA, one underline sweep, one numeral badge — never a background wash or large fill. If a section needs more visual weight, reach for the ink/paper contrast, not more lime.

rules.name: The Display/Body Split Rule
rules.body: Bricolage Grotesque is reserved for headings, large numerals, and the wordmark. Inter handles everything else — nav, buttons, labels, body copy. The two are never used interchangeably.

rules.name: The Floating-Proof Rule
rules.body: Shadow appears only on things literally presented as floating above the page (the device mockups) or as a direct response to interaction (hover, press). A resting card, section, or form panel never carries a shadow — a hairline border is enough.

dos: Do keep lime as a single deliberate mark per view — a dot, an underline, one CTA, a numeral badge — never a large fill or background wash (The One Staple Rule).
Do pair every section heading with an eyebrow label (uppercase, small lime-dot prefix) — the consistent section-intro device used across the entire page.
Do use pill radius (999px) for anything actionable or tappable, and 24px soft rectangles for content containers; never introduce a sharp 0px corner.
Do reserve soft box-shadows for floating device mockups and interactive hover/press states; keep resting surfaces flat with a hairline border instead.
Do keep the wordmark's trailing dot lime in every placement, on light or dark backgrounds.
Do write copy in first person, founder-voiced ("I", "Matt"), matching the warm, direct, unpretentious tone — never a corporate "we".
Do show the styled text fallback (never a broken image or empty box) whenever a portfolio screenshot file doesn't exist yet.
donts: Don't reach for a generic template/stock-agency look — no default corporate blue, no stock-photo hero banners, no cookie-cutter DIY-website-builder polish. This is the site's whole pitch against "look-the-same" competitors.

Don't add whimsical or cartoonish elements — mascots, novelty display fonts, playful illustration — anywhere in the system; credibility with tradespeople and professional clients depends on staying grounded.
Don't add dashboard-like density or enterprise-software chrome anywhere, including in utility sections like the enquiry form — keep the pacing spacious and marketing-page-like throughout.

Don't add an ad hoc [data-dark] section outside Pricing, the enquiry form, Final CTA, and the Footer without a real reason — the light/dark banding is a deliberate page-level rhythm, not a per-section styling choice.
Don't fill a lime numeral badge, chip, or tag with anything other than deep-lime-ink text — it's the one pairing tuned for contrast on the accent.
